description: Frontend wiring for Issue #13: (1) send the current UI language to the backend so the generated narrative is localized; (2/3) add an Amazon-model SELECTOR control (listing the Amazon Nova options plus the Claude option) near the accuracy slider and thread the choice to the request; (4) surface the data-integrity warnings from the bracket response as a non-blocking, localized banner. Depends on FEAT-002 (shared model allowlist + Lang/NarrativeLanguage) and FEAT-003 (shared integrity types + bracket response field).
steps: frontend/src/api.ts getPrediction(seriesId, season, accuracy?, lang?, model?): append &lang=<ja|en> and &model=<id> to the query string (URL-encoded) when provided, mirroring how &accuracy= is appended. Keep returning PredictionResponse.

frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.tsx: read the active language from useI18n() and pass it to getPrediction so EVERY prediction request carries the UI language (so a JA user gets a Japanese narrative, EN user English). Re-fetch when the language changes (add lang to the effect dependency list) so toggling the language refreshes the narrative. Add local state for the selected model (default = the shared DEFAULT model id) and include it in the request; re-fetch when it changes (debounce not required for a discrete select, but keep the existing accuracy debounce intact).

Add a localized model selector UI in PredictionPanel near the AccuracyControl: a <label> + <select> listing the options from the shared model allowlist (FEAT-002). Show it under the same showAccuracyControl condition (series selected and a numeric prediction is shown/loading). Use accessible markup (associated label, aria). Localize the control label and, if desired, group label; the model option display can be a friendly name (e.g. 'Amazon Nova Lite', 'Amazon Nova Micro', 'Amazon Nova Pro', 'Anthropic Claude Haiku') provided by the shared allowlist or mapped in messages.ts.

Add i18n message keys in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (both en and ja) for: the model selector label (e.g. prediction.model.selectLabel), optionally per-option friendly names if not sourced from shared, and the integrity banner text. Keep the existing MessageKey union + both language maps in sync (TypeScript will enforce completeness).

Integrity banner: consume integrityWarnings from the bracket response (getBracket in api.ts should pass the field through; if BracketResult needs the field, add it). In frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx render a non-blocking, dismissible-or-static notice (role="status") near the existing offlineNotice when integrityWarnings is non-empty, with a localized summary (e.g. EN 'Data integrity: N finished matchup(s) still reference an undetermined team.' / JA equivalent). Do not block rendering the bracket.

Update/extend frontend unit tests: PredictionPanel.test.tsx to assert the request carries the UI language and the selected model, that changing the language triggers a new request, and that the model selector renders the Amazon options. Add a HomePage/App test (or extend App.test.tsx) asserting the integrity banner renders when the bracket response includes integrityWarnings and is absent when empty.

Update frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts and frontend/e2e/prediction.spec.ts: extend the prediction stub to capture the lang and model query params (like the existing accuracy-capturing stub), add an e2e asserting the default request carries lang=ja (default) and that selecting an Amazon model + toggling language issues a new request with the chosen model and lang. Add an e2e (new spec or extend home.spec.ts) that stubs a 2026 bracket containing a finished placeholder matchup with integrityWarnings and asserts the integrity banner is visible; and that a clean bracket shows no banner.
Run the e2e suite headless (npx playwright install chromium first if needed).
acceptance_criteria: Every /prediction request issued by the SPA carries the current UI language; toggling language re-requests and the narrative reflects the new language (verified via stubbed request-param capture in e2e and unit tests).
An accessible, localized model selector lists the Amazon Nova options (plus Claude) and the chosen model is sent on the request; selecting a different model issues a new request with that model id.
When the bracket response includes integrityWarnings, a non-blocking localized banner appears; when empty, no banner appears.
`npm run build`, `npm test -w @mlb/frontend`, and `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` pass.
findings: Implemented FEAT-004 (frontend wiring for Issue #13). Files changed (feature commit e315f73): frontend/src/api.ts (getPrediction now takes optional lang + model and appends &lang=/&model= URL-encoded; added NarrativeLanguage import; getBracket unchanged - the returned bracket already carries the optional integrityWarnings via the shared Bracket type); frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.tsx (reads lang from useI18n(), new model local state defaulting to DEFAULT_NARRATIVE_MODEL_ID, both threaded onto every getPrediction call and added to the effect deps so toggling language or model re-fetches; accuracy debounce preserved; new accessible ModelControl label+select built from NARRATIVE_MODEL_OPTIONS, rendered under the existing showAccuracyControl condition); frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (added MessageKeys prediction.model.selectLabel and integrity.banner with {count}, EN+JA); frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx (non-blocking role=status integrity banner shown when bracket.integrityWarnings is non-empty, near offlineNotice; model option labels sourced from shared allowlist); frontend/src/styles.css (styles for .prediction__model-control/.prediction__model-select and .app__notice--integrity). Tests: frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.test.tsx (updated existing call-signature assertions to 5-arg form; added language-change re-request test via a setLang harness, and a model-selector test asserting all Amazon Nova options render and selecting Nova Pro re-requests with its id); frontend/src/App.test.tsx (added integrity-banner-present and clean-no-banner tests); frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts (added stubPredictionCapturingLangModel + CapturedPredictionRequest and stubBracket2026WithIntegrityWarnings); frontend/e2e/prediction.spec.ts (added localization+model e2e asserting default lang=ja + default model, model change + language toggle re-request; added integrity-banner e2e asserting banner visible for flagged bracket and absent for clean). Verification all green: `npm run build` (monorepo) OK; `npm test -w @mlb/frontend` 39 passed (6 files); `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` 20 passed (chromium already installed); full `npm test` across workspaces also green (infra 6 passed with only pre-existing nodejs20.x deprecation warnings). No deviations from the plan. Note: the language-change unit test uses a setLang harness because the I18nProvider language is state, not a prop, so re-rendering with a different initialLang does not change it. Separate task-state chore commit follows.
